product_overview: A lightweight, Jira-like project management web app for planning, tracking, and delivering work across teams. It provides boards, backlogs, issue detail editing, search, dashboards, and team/goal management in a single workspace.
core_goals: Enable teams to plan and track work using boards and backlogs
Make creating, finding, and updating issues fast and low-friction
Provide team and goal views to improve ownership and cross-team visibility
Help stakeholders see delivery progress via dashboards and project summaries
Support quick discovery of work through global search and saved filters

features.name: User Login
features.description: Sign in to a workspace using an email-based login flow to reach the dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Submit login form -> See dashboard at /home

features.name: Projects List
features.description: Browse, search, filter, and sort projects in the workspace to open project-level pages.
user_flows: Navigate to /projects -> View projects list with name, key, type, and lead -> Filter projects by type or search text -> Sort projects by a column -> Select a project from the list -> See the selected project's pages and navigation (board, backlog, summary)

features.name: Project Board (Kanban)
features.description: View and manage issues on a drag-and-drop board where columns represent workflow states.
user_flows: Navigate to /projects -> Select a project from the list -> View issue cards organized in workflow columns (To Do, In Progress, Done, etc.) -> Drag an issue card from one column to another to change status -> Open an issue card to view or edit its details

features.name: Sprint Backlog Management
features.description: Plan sprints, prioritize work, and move issues between sprint sections in the backlog.
user_flows: Navigate to /projects -> Select a project from the list -> Open the backlog view for the project -> View backlog grouped by sprint and unscheduled items -> Collapse and expand a sprint section -> Drag an issue between sprint sections to reprioritize -> Start a sprint -> Complete a sprint and confirm completion when prompted

features.name: Issue Detail View
features.description: Inspect and edit full issue details with inline editing and an auto-save indicator.
user_flows: Navigate to /search -> Type a search query and view results -> Open an issue result to view the issue detail -> Edit the issue summary inline -> Edit the description field -> Change issue type, status, or priority -> Assign or change the assignee and reporter -> Set sprint, epic, story points, or labels -> Add a comment and submit it using Cmd/Ctrl+Enter -> See the auto-save indicator reflect saving and saved states

features.name: Global Search
features.description: Search across issues, projects, and users and navigate directly to results.
user_flows: Navigate to /search -> Type a search query in the search input -> View grouped results for issues, projects, and users -> Apply optional filters such as status or assignee -> Select a result to navigate to that item's page or detail view

features.name: Dashboards
features.description: Create and view custom dashboards composed of widgets and manage dashboard favorites and filters.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboards -> View the list of dashboards with owner and viewer info -> Click Create Dashboard to open the creation dialog -> Fill the dashboard creation form and submit -> Open a created dashboard to view widgets and data snapshots -> Star a dashboard to favorite it -> Filter dashboards by owner

features.name: Filters (Saved Searches)
features.description: Save, browse, and manage filter queries to quickly revisit common issue sets.
user_flows: Navigate to /filters -> Browse saved filters in the list -> Open a saved filter to view its results -> Create a new filter by defining query criteria and saving it -> Edit a saved filter's name or criteria -> Delete a saved filter

features.name: Goals / OKR Tracking
features.description: Define and track goals with status, owners, and progress metrics to connect work to outcomes.
user_flows: Navigate to /goals -> View a list of goals with status indicators (ON TRACK, AT RISK, OFF TRACK) -> Filter goals by tag, status, owner, team, or starred -> Click Create Goal to open the creation dialog and fill goal details -> Open a goal to view its progress metrics and details -> Follow or unfollow a goal to receive updates in the UI

features.name: Teams Management
features.description: Discover, create, and manage teams and their membership within the workspace.
user_flows: Navigate to /teams -> Browse the teams list to discover teams -> Open the team directory at /teams/directory to search for teams -> Create a new team by filling the creation form -> Open a team's detail view to see members and responsibilities -> Join or leave a team from the team detail view

features.name: Plans and Roadmap
features.description: Create and manage release plans and roadmaps with selected work sources and access settings.
user_flows: Navigate to /plans -> View the list of plans with descriptions and access levels -> Click Create Plan to open the creation form -> Fill the plan creation form including name, sources, and access level -> Select work sources (space, board, filter) -> Create the plan and view it in the plans list

features.name: Navigation & Sidebar
features.description: Use the app sidebar and top navigation to move between workspace surfaces, access user settings, and toggle UI preferences.
user_flows: Navigate to /home -> Use sidebar links to navigate between dashboard, projects, teams, search, goals, and other sections -> Expand or collapse sidebar sections to change navigation density -> Use the top navigation bar to start a search or access contextual actions -> Toggle dark or light theme -> Click the user avatar to open profile and account settings and to sign out

tech_stack: DND-Kit (drag-and-drop), Recharts, cmdk, Sonner, Vaul, date-fns

known_limitations.issue: Authentication is mock - any email input redirects to home without validation
known_limitations.impact: No real credential validation or session management

known_limitations.issue: All data is in-memory mock data, not persisted to a database
known_limitations.impact: All changes are lost on page refresh or server restart

known_limitations.issue: Admin panel routes are UI stubs with no real functionality
known_limitations.impact: 40+ admin pages render but have no working CRUD operations

known_limitations.issue: Notifications are UI-only with no real notification system
known_limitations.impact: Shows static notification UI but no real push/email notifications

known_limitations.issue: Project templates gallery does not create actual projects
Code integration view is a UI stub
